def transform(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
 # follow alternating wall openings, connect nearest opening across intervening blank bands
 walls=[r for r in range(h) if 8 in g[r]]
 sr=next((r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2),0); sc=next(c for c,x in enumerate(g[sr]) if x==2)
 cur=sc
 for wr in walls:
  gaps=[c for c,x in enumerate(g[wr]) if x!=8]
  if not gaps: continue
  target=min(gaps,key=lambda x:abs(x-cur))
  # connect on row immediately before wall
  rr=wr-1
  for c in range(min(cur,target),max(cur,target)+1):
   if out[rr][c]==0: out[rr][c]=2
  # project target through wall and until next wall
  if out[wr][target]==0: out[wr][target]=2
  for r in range(wr+1, h):
   if r in walls: break
   if out[r][target]==0: out[r][target]=2
  cur=target
 return out
